note: Provenance of public/media. All images are Riot Games' official product renders and print artwork. Crop boxes are x,y,w,h in pixels of the full-size source. tear = where the crimped top seal ends, as a fraction of the cut-out's height.

rad.retouch: Transparent render; the pack stands in front of the booster display. Left 5 columns recoloured from the pack's own edge where the box's gold trim showed through; top-left corner alpha mirrored from the top-right.

ven.retouch: Opaque JPG on white (Riot has no transparent single-pack render for Vendetta): alpha matted from the white background at the edges and hand-cut where the display box is behind the left edge.

unl.retouch: Transparent render; left edge rebuilt as a sub-pixel mask where the pack overlaps the display box.

sfd.retouch: Transparent render of the pack alone; no retouching.

ogn.retouch: Transparent render of the pack alone; no retouching.

cardBack.crop: PDF page 5, rendered at 1200 dpi: main deck back at 4536,6267,2976,4156; rune deck back at 1205,6267,2976,4156
cardBack.retouch: Vector artwork from Riot's How to Play PDF. The 10 px page-white band at the very edge repainted in the card's background colour; rounded corners masked at the PDF's own 8.504 pt radius.
